tool_input.command:
cd /tmp && mkdir -p test-eval && cd test-eval && cat > outputs.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "test"]
EOF
cat > references.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "different"]
EOF

cat > test-eval-comprehensive.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

echo "=== Test 1: Basic eval without thresholds ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs "$(pwd)/test-outputs.json" --references "$(pwd)/test-references.json" --report "/tmp/test-basic.json" --format json
echo "✓ Exit code 0 (no thresholds)"

echo ""
echo "=== Test 2: Eval with passing threshold ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs "$(pwd)/test-outputs.json" --references "$(pwd)/test-references.json" --report "/tmp/test-pass.json" --format json --threshold "exact_match=0.5"
EXIT=$?
if [ $EXIT -eq 0 ]; then echo "✓ Exit code 0 (threshold passed)"; else echo "✗ Expected 0, got $EXIT"; fi

echo ""
echo "=== Test 3: Eval with failing threshold ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs "$(pwd)/test-outputs.json" --references "$(pwd)/test-references.json" --report "/tmp/test-fail.json" --format json --threshold "exact_match=0.95"
EXIT=$?
if [ $EXIT -eq 1 ]; then echo "✓ Exit code 1 (threshold failed)"; else echo "✗ Expected 1, got $EXIT"; fi

echo ""
echo "=== Test 4: Multiple thresholds ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs "$(pwd)/test-outputs.json" --references "$(pwd)/test-references.json" --report "/tmp/test-multi.md" --format markdown --threshold "exact_match=0.5" --threshold "toxicity=0.5"
EXIT=$?
if [ $EXIT -eq 1 ]; then echo "✓ Exit code 1 (at least one failed)"; else echo "✗ Expected 1, got $EXIT"; fi
echo "Markdown report preview:"
tail -10 /tmp/test-multi.md

echo ""
echo "=== Test 5: Invalid threshold format ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs "$(pwd)/test-outputs.json" --references "$(pwd)/test-references.json" --threshold "invalid" 2>&1 || true
EXIT=$?
if [ $EXIT -eq 2 ]; then echo "✓ Exit code 2 (malformed threshold)"; else echo "✗ Expected 2, got $EXIT"; fi

echo ""
echo "=== Test 6: Unknown metric ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs "$(pwd)/test-outputs.json" --references "$(pwd)/test-references.json" --threshold "unknown_metric=0.5" 2>&1 || true
EXIT=$?
if [ $EXIT -eq 2 ]; then echo "✓ Exit code 2 (unknown metric)"; else echo "✗ Expected 2, got $EXIT"; fi

echo ""
echo "=== Test 7: Threshold value out of range ==="
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs "$(pwd)/test-outputs.json" --references "$(pwd)/test-references.json" --threshold "exact_match=1.5" 2>&1 || true
EXIT=$?
if [ $EXIT -eq 2 ]; then echo "✓ Exit code 2 (invalid threshold value)"; else echo "✗ Expected 2, got $EXIT"; fi

echo ""
echo "✅ All tests passed!"
EOF
bash test-eval-comprehensive.sh
